coupon_solves_semantics: NEW coupon.pipeline.simulate_run solves performed by this run (cache misses since the start of main); 0 means the (run, theta, resolution) solve was already cached in this process. All 25 positions share it.

kmix.sensitivity_scope: full 5x5 level-set grid at k_mix=0 in the levelset_kmix0 columns; these use the feature.calibrate.predict defaults (suppressor already False, k_mix=0, ohmic LEFT AT THE Params DEFAULT True). The Task 4 reference additionally sets ohmic=False, so they differ from it by the ohmic term only - not the same configuration
kmix.note: k_mix is the level-set eddy-mixing surrogate (feature.engine.params). It is a MODEL SWITCH, not a parameter fitted to the trench data: the main columns use the feature.calibrate default 1.0, the sensitivity columns use 0.0. The flow model has no k_mix term and is evaluated once.

flat_site.verdict: the coupon model's absolute level is too high at EVERY position: its planar minimum is above the measured flat-site thickness, so 39.5 um cannot be attributed to any coupon position; this is a coupon-model level error, not evidence that coupon position is irrelevant

notes: the coupon pipeline is DC (one steady state); the feature model applies each site's pulse-reverse block (9/0.5/0.5 ms, rr = 2) on top of the DC local current, so PR effects on the trench-mouth concentration are not in the coupon conditions [J]
the SEM site positions on the coupon are unknown: a 5x5 grid at +-0.8/+-0.4/0 cm is swept and only the distribution of predictions is comparable with the measured intervals [J]
the flat-site comparison uses the coupon Faraday thickness (planar, no trench) with the coupon calibration sigma; it tests the coupon model, not the feature models [C]
level-set wall thickness is not reported by feature.calibrate.predict (no wall split); the flow model reports wall_up/wall_down means [J]
nothing was fitted to the trench data: theta is coupon/calibration.json, and the feature models use their own calibrated/default parameters (trench_calibration.json efficiency is NOT used) [C]
grid nodes stop 0.2 cm inside the coupon edge because the cell solve has an edge singularity on the boundary nodes [J]

interval = [lo, hi] when hi > lo (the measured range; sigma = max((hi - lo)/2, 3 um) is reported for weighting only); a degenerate interval (hi == lo, e.g. the narrow floor 53-53) uses best +/- 3 um, the reading floor of feature/calibrate.py:162-165; non-degenerate intervals are therefore the measured ranges (wide field 79-91, wide floor 72-78, narrow field 69-80 um) and only the degenerate narrow floor (lo = hi = 53 um) is widened to 50-56 um [C]

mean-current criterion: the AREA-WEIGHTED j_mean = 15.148 mA/cm2 vs j_set x front_fraction = 15.000 mA/cm2 (+1.0 %, inside the 5 % bound). The PLAIN mean of the 25 interior samples is 13.887 mA/cm2 (-7.4 %) because the 0.2 cm edge ring is excluded and the cell solve puts ~20-40 % extra current there; the interior average is therefore expected to be low and is NOT the 5 % test [C]

flat-site reading: the predicted planar minimum (56.0 um) is +16.5 um (+42 %) above the measured 39.5 um at EVERY position, i.e. the coupon model's absolute level is too high, so 39.5 um cannot be attributed to a coupon position; this is a coupon-model level error, not evidence that position is irrelevant [J]
one coupon pipeline solve serves all 25 positions (conditions are sampled in the parent and passed to the workers); the run is recorded in 'coupon_solves' [C]

k_mix SENSITIVITY (model switch, NOT a fit): the level-set eddy-mixing surrogate is at k_mix=1 in the main columns and k_mix=0 in the 'LS k0' columns. Narrow site: floor 73.3 um (ratio 0.958) at k_mix=1 vs 61.8 um (ratio 0.786) at k_mix=0, against the measured 53 um (0.768). k_mix > 0 adds an eddy diffusivity inside the feature, which mixes the trench and suppresses the additive-free bottom-up signal. Scope of the k_mix=0 columns: the feature.calibrate.predict defaults (suppressor already False, k_mix=0, ohmic LEFT AT THE Params DEFAULT True); the Task 4 reference additionally sets ohmic=False, so the k=0 columns differ from it by the ohmic term only - they are not the same configuration [J]
k_mix SENSITIVITY, wide site: floor 79.2 um (ratio 0.976) at k_mix=1 vs 68.7 um (ratio 0.821) at k_mix=0, measured 75 um (0.915) [J]

conclusion split: the earlier 'no coupon position reproduces the narrow floor' statement holds only for the k_mix>0 surrogate. With k_mix=0 the narrow floor/ratio moves towards the measurement, so the low narrow floor must be read as (a) a coupon-position effect PLUS (b) the k_mix>0 surrogate suppressing the bottom-up signal; it is not a position-only explanation and not fitted here [J]
